attempts.summary: Set up PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on Alpine Linux. Demonstrated failover: stopped node1's postgres, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero committed-data loss, repointed node3 to follow node2, then rejoined node1 as a standby of node2 via pg_basebackup. Finally executed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on all three nodes, proving boot-identity change (boot_id) and post-reboot recovery of postgres role, replication streaming, and cluster data on each.
